_about: Event pool source (DW-205). Imported into DA_Event_* by UDwRunContentLibrary (Tools/CreateCombatContent.ps1). Layers are 1-based as the player counts nodes (layer 1 = the first node); the importer stores them 0-based. Empty outcomes become an explicit Nothing. Drafted by the content pipeline (Docs/ContentPipeline/out/*/final.json, 2026-11-17); open critic findings in each batch report.md still need Brandon.

events.title: The Drifting Wreck
events.body: A merchant hull lies on her side in the swell, masts gone, hold half under. Something glints below the waterline. The tide is turning, and she won't float much longer.

choices.label: Strip the deck
choices.resultText: Brass fittings, a purse in a dead man's coat. Small, but it's yours.

choices.label: Dive the hold
choices.resultText: Your diver comes up with a full chest, or comes up empty-handed and bleeding from the timbers.

choices.label: Leave her to the sea
choices.resultText: You hold your course. Nothing happens, and behind you the wreck slips under.

events.title: A Peddler's Sloop
events.body: A little sloop runs up her colours and comes alongside. Her captain has crates of tonics lashed to the rail and a nervous smile. He names a fair price, which is how you know he wants to be gone.

choices.label: Buy two tonics
choices.resultText: Two bottles for forty gold. Cheaper than any port will sell them.

choices.label: Let him see your captain
choices.resultText: He takes one look at the beard and calls it a gift. He sails off fast.

choices.label: Wave him off
choices.resultText: Nothing changes hands. The sloop goes off looking for an easier crew.

events.title: Castaway on a Spar
events.body: A man clings to a broken spar, cutlass still in his belt. He says he was a master-at-arms until his ship went down two nights ago. He'll pay for a ride to shore with the heavy purse around his neck, or work off his passage drilling your crew.

choices.label: Put him to work
choices.resultText: Three days of blade drill on a rolling deck. He keeps his purse, and your crew stops dropping their guard.

choices.label: Take the purse
choices.resultText: You row him to a sandbar and take your fare. A fair trade, more or less.

events.title: The Hidden Shoal
events.body: The keel grinds and the whole ship shudders to a stop. You've run onto a sandbank the chart never showed. The tide is going out, and the hull groans with every wave.

choices.label: Force her off
choices.resultText: Full sail drags her free, and leaves half the keel on the sand.

choices.label: Over the side and push
choices.resultText: Waist-deep in cold water, the crew heaves her clear. The hull barely notices. The crew's shoulders do.

choices.label: Lighten the hold
choices.resultText: Over go stores and a chest of coin. She floats off clean, and you're poorer for it.

events.title: The Rival's Cache
events.body: A tarred barrel bobs on a short line, painted with a rival crew's mark. Below it, the rope runs taut into green water. Someone sank their plunder here and meant to come back for it.

choices.label: Cut the purse free
choices.resultText: Your diver saws through the line and comes up with a fat purse and a gashed arm.

choices.label: Bring up the whole chest
choices.resultText: You get a hook on the chest and start hauling. The sea decides the rest.

choices.label: Strip the marker barrel
choices.resultText: Under the tar, the barrel is packed with someone's spare medicine. You leave the line to its owners.

events.title: Deserters in a Longboat
events.body: A longboat bumps against your hull. The sailors in it walked off a rival ship two nights ago and haven't eaten since. One still has a sword and another has a long rifle wrapped in sailcloth.

choices.label: Wave the swordsman aboard
choices.resultText: You wave the swordsman over the rail. Whether there's a bunk to spare is another matter.

choices.label: Wave the marksman aboard
choices.resultText: You wave the marksman over the rail. Whether there's a bunk to spare is another matter.

choices.label: Trade rations for medicine
choices.resultText: They give up two stolen medicine kits for a sack of hardtack and a few coins. Nobody asks whose they were.

events.title: Squall Line
events.body: The horizon goes black from end to end. The wind turns against you, and the first rain hits the deck sideways. You have a minute to decide how to take it.

choices.label: Run before the wind
choices.resultText: You outrun the worst of it, but the hull takes a beating from the waves on the way.

choices.label: Reef sails and hold
choices.resultText: Everyone works the rigging until their hands bleed. The ship mostly holds.

choices.label: Drive straight through
choices.resultText: You put the bow into the black and hold on. Whatever the sea took, it took fast.

events.title: Mutterings Below Deck
events.body: The talk stops whenever you go below. Too many fights and too few shares have soured the crew. By morning, somebody will act on it.

choices.label: Pay out shares
choices.resultText: Coin goes around the deck and the muttering stops. For now.

choices.label: Settle it with fists
choices.resultText: The captain takes the ringleader on in front of everyone and wins, barely. No one mutters after that.

choices.label: Let it fester
choices.resultText: You leave them to it and turn in. By morning, the crew has settled it their own way.

events.title: The Turning Brig
events.body: A brig limps past on the other tack, her foremast gone and her rail torn open. Her captain shouts across that he has seen what waits ahead and is going home. He has no more use for what's in his hold.

choices.label: Take his planks
choices.resultText: His crew pass over timber and pitch. By dusk the worst of your holes are shut.

choices.label: Take his medicine chest
choices.resultText: Two tonics, corked and sealed. He says he won't be needing them where he's going.

choices.label: Pay for the whole lot
choices.resultText: He takes your coin for the road home and lends you his carpenter for the afternoon. Your ship sails on sounder than it has in weeks.

events.title: The Tally Rock
events.body: A black rock stands alone in the swell, cut all over with names. Every crew that sailed on to the Kraken stopped here first. Under a cairn at its foot sits a strongbox and a page of notes, weighted with a stone.

choices.label: Open the strongbox
choices.resultText: Old coin, still dry. Whoever left it isn't coming back for it.

choices.label: Read the notes aloud
choices.resultText: Scrawled warnings about tentacles, timing and where to stand. The crew make you read it twice.

choices.label: Keep the notes to yourself
choices.resultText: You read every page alone, then pocket half the coin and leave the rest under the cairn. The crew don't need to know how it ends. You'll be the one ending it.

events.title: Wreckers Among the Hulls
events.body: Broken ships lie on their sides in the shallows, ribs open to the sky. A wrecker crew is stripping them, and their longboats are already pulling your way. Their captain wants a toll, or your hull for parts.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.resultText: They count it twice and row off. Cheaper than a fight this close to the end.

choices.label: Run the shallows
choices.resultText: You scrape over a sunken keel to get clear. The hull takes it badly, but the purse stays full.

choices.label: Let them see your face
choices.resultText: You light the fuses in your beard and stand at the rail. The longboats scatter, some fast enough to drop their purses, some too close to stop before they ram you.

events.title: Something Under the Keel
events.body: The water goes flat and dark. Something long passes beneath the ship, slow enough that you can count the seconds. Then the deck lifts under your feet.

choices.label: Hold on and ride it out
choices.resultText: It rises once more and is gone. Whatever it cost the hull, you hear it groaning for an hour after.

choices.label: Dump the cargo and run
choices.resultText: Crates of plunder go over the side and the ship rides higher. Whatever it was loses interest.

choices.label: Every hand to the pumps
choices.resultText: Nobody waits to be told. They bail until their hands bleed, and the ship stays dry enough to sail.
